Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have highlighted approval limits in our annual reviews, and your cost breakdown suggests any adjustment needs a clear internal justification. We want to recognise genuine cost pressure and reach a sustainable agreement within your offer’s validity. How can we balance price and payment timing in a way that works commercially for you without an unnecessary committee referral?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have registered your updated volume forecast, which enables us to apply a corresponding volume discount to our calculation.
Please note that extending payment terms to 90 days would necessitate a price increase to offset internal financing costs.
To offer you the most advantageous commercial conditions, we propose maintaining the standard 30-day payment term at a revised price of EUR 369.02.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You separate financing costs from the motor price, and Credit Control reinforces the payment concern—it seems payment timing is central to your flexibility. We want to recognise legitimate costs transparently and preserve a fair, stable partnership. How can we balance that financing concern with a further measured adjustment to the price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
